chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel, from Fazeyl, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'What is the stipulation (option of return) in animals?' He said, 'Up to three days for the buyer.' I said, 'So what is the stipulation regarding other than animals?' He said, 'The two parties are with the choice as long as they have not separated. So when they separate, there is no choice after their agreement from both of them.'

key_terms.الْحَيَوَان: Animals (specifically live livestock in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the duration of the return option (khiyar) for animals versus other goods in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the foundational rules of 'khiyar al-shart' (option of stipulation), distinguishing between the fixed three-day period for live animals and the immediate termination of the option upon parting ways for other goods. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on contractual clarity and the prevention of dispute by defining the precise moment when a sale becomes binding and irrevocable.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel, from Fazeyl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is the stipulation regarding the animals?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Up to three days for the buyer’. I said, ‘So what is the stipulation regarding other than the animals’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The two parties are with the choice for as long as they have not separated. So when they both separate, so there is no choice after the agreement from both of them’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Jamil from Fudayl who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

‘What is a stipulation in a deal for animals ? 5 He (the Imam) replied, ‘It is valid for three days in favor of a buyer . 5 I then asked, ‘What is it in a deal for non-animal ? 5 He (the Imam) replied, ‘A buyer and a seller have the choice to dismiss a deal until they depart each other. After their departing each other there is no choice after their agreement.’”
